label: EVENT_LOGIC_V2_1_FREEZE
author: maxime@qwokka.fr
supersession_reason: V2 _detect_takeoff HURDLE used physical y convention (global min y = highest point) but phase_m_canary_check.py passes cy_norm directly (y=0=top). Global-min-y finds the FLIGHT apex (lower cy_norm ~0.12) rather than the HURDLE apex (~0.18), triggering false board_recontact near flight apex and failing to find final takeoff. V2 also had _detect_apex fallback finding max-y instead of min-y in cy_norm. V2.1 fixes both using cy_norm convention throughout.

trajectory_families.H2_HURDLE: plateau + hurdle ascent (y↓) + descent (y↑) + board loading + final takeoff (y↓ strongly) + flight + water

key_fixes._detect_takeoff_HURDLE_apex: FIRST local minimum via first neg→non-neg velocity crossing (NOT global min y). Correct even when flight apex has lower cy_norm than hurdle apex.
key_fixes._detect_takeoff_HURDLE_board_recontact: Directly from the velocity crossing frame (no second search loop needed).
key_fixes._detect_apex: First neg→pos velocity crossing after takeoff; fallback = min y in [takeoff, takeoff+window].
key_fixes.coordinate_convention: cy_norm throughout: 0=top of frame. Rising diver = NEGATIVE velocity. Apex = minimum cy_norm. Water contact = y > water_line_cy_norm.

phase_m_regression.description: Non-sinusoidal hurdle trajectory in cy_norm; no false board_recontact
phase_m_regression.note: Phase M original failure (sinusoidal trajectory) documented in PHASE_M_CANARY_CHECK_AUDIT.json. V2.1 test uses physically correct trajectory.

known_limitations: Canary ground-truth evaluation still blocked by perception: L1 produces 0 detections on Paris canary.
V2.1 tested only on synthetic trajectories (H1/H2/H3). Real-world trajectory required after detector repair.
hurdle_post_plateau_guard_s parameter must exceed total preparation plateau duration; H3 (2.0s prep) uses default=3.5s which absorbs it.
Water contact via cy_norm threshold is pool/framing dependent; E2 water_line_auto mitigates but not selected for INTERNAL_EVAL.
Board re-contact via first velocity crossing may be fragile if hurdle is very low or trajectory is noisy.
evaluation_gate: PERCEPTION_STILL_INSUFFICIENT — cannot evaluate on real canary until detector repaired
